forbidden.name: feature-isolation
forbidden.comment: Features should be isolated and not import from other features.

forbidden.name: shared-ui-purity
forbidden.comment: Shared UI components cannot import from features (prevents coupling).

forbidden.name: logic-ui-separation
forbidden.comment: Headless logic (src/lib) cannot import from UI/Features.

forbidden.name: no-circular
